target_customer: Robotics companies and developers who run or fine-tune robot foundation models
problem: Robot AI models are growing too compute hungry to run on the robot, and generic clouds add too much latency for real-time control.
business_model: Usage-based cloud: about $5 per robot-hour for inference and $6.84 per GPU-hour for training, per the website
product_category: Cloud inference and training infrastructure for robotics

founders.name: Kevin Lin
founders.background_notes: YC page: former quant turned roboticist, two silver medals at the International Chemistry Olympiad.

founders.name: Antoine Nguyen
founders.background_notes: YC page: VLA quantization researcher at UTS.

competitors.name: Physical Intelligence Pi API
competitors.what: Hosted fine-tuning and inference gateway for its robot foundation models

technical_complexity.rationale: Cutting latency requires kernel level GPU work, model changes and network transport tuning, which is hard for four people.

defensibility.rationale: Latency engineering is a real edge, but model labs and big clouds can offer hosted inference themselves.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Model labs began launching hosted APIs in October 2026; no outcome yet.

market_need_then: Robot foundation models were growing in 2026 and funding to the sector was large; some analysis says quantized models can run on-device, which cuts against cloud inference.

branding.domain_note: Uses dreamscalelabs.com; no purchase story found

identity.logo: not described; site shows YC and NVIDIA Inception logos

branding.brand_signature: The real-time cloud for physical AI

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; the name resembles other Dream companies such as Dream Labs, which raised a large seed in October 2026.

outcome_analysis: Dreamscale Labs is a four person Fall 2026 YC company selling low latency cloud inference for robots, in research preview. No funding disclosure, exit or distress is public. Its bet that robot inference stays in the cloud, against model labs launching APIs and on-device quantization, will decide the outcome.
notes: No funding figure found beyond the standard YC deal, which is not recorded. Dream Labs (a $90M seed, October 2026, robot control API) is a different company. Pi API coverage is secondary and recent relative to the batch.
